title: Za'atar Manakish with Garlic, Onion and Mint Cheese
changes_from_base: The za'atar oil is spread on thinner rolled and docked rounds baked on a very hot stone, and each one gets a second layer of mozzarella with garlic, grated onion and dried mint partway through, instead of plain za'atar flatbreads served with salad.
summary: Paper-thin flatbreads with a choice of toppings—either spiced za'atar and olive oil, or molten mozzarella with garlic and dried mint.
equipment: pizza stone, baking steel or heavy baking tray

ingredients.item: strong white bread flour, plus extra for dusting
fine sea salt or table salt
extra-virgin olive oil, for the bowl
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Mix dough
steps.text: Stir flour, salt, yeast and caster sugar together in the mixer bowl, pour in the warm water gradually by hand until you have a shaggy dough (about 1 min), then knead with the hook on medium-high for 3 min until smooth and slightly sticky.

steps.title: First rise
steps.text: Oil a bowl, turn the dough into it to coat, cover and leave approximately 45 min until nearly doubled in size.

steps.title: Divide
steps.text: Cut into 4 equal portions of about 108 g each, roll each into a tight ball, space them apart, cover and leave another 45 min.

steps.title: Heat oven
steps.text: Set the oven to its highest temperature (260 °C or above) with the pizza stone, steel or an upturned heavy baking tray on the lowest shelf.

steps.title: Make toppings
steps.text: Mix the za'atar with its olive oil and salt in one small bowl; in another, combine the finely grated garlic, grated onion, mozzarella, olive oil and crumbled dried mint; chop the fresh mint leaves and set aside.

steps.title: Top and bake
steps.text: Flour the pizza peel, roll one dough ball on a floured surface to a 23 cm circle, prick all over with a fork, place on the peel, spread a quarter of the za'atar mix to within 3 mm of the edge, slide onto the hot stone and bake for 3–4 min until golden with a few charred spots, turning with tongs if needed (for the cheese version, scatter a quarter of the cheese mixture after 2 min and bake 1–2 min longer).

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.text: Slide onto a board, rest for 3 min, scatter with fresh mint, then cut into quarters or fold in half.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.text: Cook the remaining three in the same way, allowing the peel to cool between batches.

tips: Prick the dough all over so it doesn't puff up like a cushion and stays blistered and crisp.
Use a pizza peel lightly dusted with flour and slide it onto the stone with a quick, confident motion to stop it sticking.
Let the peel cool briefly between rounds—a warm peel will stick to the next dough ball.
storage: Store leftover manakish chilled for up to 2 days, or freeze for up to 3 months; reheat at 120 °C for about 10 min. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
